nameOrigin: electromagnetic radiation that can ‘see through’ certain objects

pokedexEntries.di: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

pokedexEntries.prl: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.

pokedexEntries.pt: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

pokedexEntries.hgss: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
